protocol.tokens: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2@1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41, last hidden state, max 256 word pieces, [CLS]/[SEP] dropped (kept only when nothing else remains), each token l2-normalised; pooled vector = the model's mean pooling + l2 over all word pieces
protocol.maxsim: sum over query tokens of the max cosine over document tokens, divided by the query token count; maxsim_idf weights query tokens by wordpiece idf; maxsim_centered subtracts the corpus-mean token embedding from every token and renormalises
protocol.projection: R (384 x D) with entries N(0, 1/D), the first D columns of one 384 x 16384 draw (seed 20241020); RFF phases U[0, 2 pi) from the same generator; gamma 4.0

token_maps.rff: sqrt(2/D) cos(sqrt(2 gamma D) R^T x + b)

protocol.grouping: pos<B>: relative position bucket floor(p B / n); kmeans<K>: seeded spherical k-means on the document's token embeddings (10 iterations, seed 7); sup: one D-vector, group g bound by np.roll(., g D / G); sep: G stored D-vectors
protocol.bundle: int8: per-row symmetric int8 (scale = max|x| / 127), dequantised and l2-normalised; bin: sign of the sum, query tokens binarised, score = +-1 dot / D (affine in the Hamming distance)
protocol.score: sum_t w_t max_g <key_g(h(q_t)), M_d> / (|M_d| sum_t w_t) for sup (G rolled query copies); max over the G stored vectors (cosine each, empty groups masked) for sep; w_t = 1 or idf

additions.A_idf: token hypervectors weighted by BM25-style wordpiece idf before summing; query tokens weighted by the same idf in the score
additions.B_kmeans: K semantic groups per document stored separately (memory K x D)
additions.C_expand: x <- l2(x + lambda sum_i s_i p_i): p_i = corpus-mean contextual embedding of the 3 occurring vocabulary items nearest to x's wordpiece in the model's tied word-embedding matrix, s_i = their cosine (clipped at 0), lambda 1.0; documents only
additions.D_rerank: candidates = dense top-100 union positive-BM25 top-100; non-candidates unretrieved; reported as metrics.rerank for every row
additions.E_meansub: M_{d,g} -= W_{d,g} h_bar, h_bar = weight-mean token hypervector over the corpus

protocol.hybrid: metrics.hybrid_bm25 = per-query z-score of the row + z-score of BM25 (k1 1.2, b 0.75, WARM tokeniser from benchmarks/research/roc/roc.py)
protocol.metrics: nDCG@10 with linear gain over all judged grades, recall@100 over grade > 0, lower document index wins ties; all queries plus the odd (tune) / even (eval) split
protocol.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap of the mean nDCG@10 difference, 2000 resamples, seed 0, one shared index matrix per dataset (all) and per eval split
protocol.memory: dense 1536 B; maxsim tokens x 384 x 2 (fp16; fp32 also recorded); int8 bundle G x (D + 4); binary G x D / 8
protocol.cost: madds_per_doc = mean query tokens x G x D (dense 384, maxsim q x d x 384, puresum D); bitops_per_doc for binary rows (XOR + popcount over G x D bits per query token)
protocol.verdict: per dataset and D: PASS iff an hli row with memory <= 4 x dense beats dense on nDCG@10 by >= 0.02 with 95% CI excluding 0 (first stage, all queries); overall PASS iff some D passes on every dataset; best_by_tune_split selects on the tune split and reports the eval split
protocol.timing: scoring_wall_s = one full pass at --threads; ms_per_query_1thread = median of --time-repeats repeats after one warm-up on --time-queries queries with torch threads = 1
